name: Diviner
summary: Diviner; Universal, Divination; Foresight, danger sense, accuracy, fate manipulation, and reading echoes.  Diviner; Once per short rest, add or subtract 1d4 from a d20 roll made by a creature you can see.  Diviner; When you use a reaction power, you may move 5 ft without provoking opportunity attacks.  Diviner; Once per long rest, replace a d20 roll made by a creature you can see with a 10 before modifiers.
descriptionMarkdown:
Diviner; Universal, Divination; Foresight, danger sense, accuracy, fate manipulation, and reading echoes.
